build.buildCommand: set -e; corepack enable 2>/dev/null || true; corepack prepare pnpm@8.15.9 --activate 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then :; elif [ -f ../../pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then cd ../..; fi; echo "Building from $(pwd)"; pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile; rm -rf apps/web-main/.next; pnpm turbo run build --filter=web-main --force; SA=$(find . -type d -path '*/.next/standalone' -print -quit); echo "standalone dir: $SA"; ls -la "$SA" || true; SRV=$(find "$SA" -name server.js -print -quit); echo "server.js: $SRV"; if [ -z "$SRV" ]; then echo 'ERROR: standalone server.js not produced by build'; find apps/web-main/.next -maxdepth 3 -type d 2>/dev/null | head -50; exit 1; fi; SDIR=$(dirname "$SRV"); mkdir -p "$SDIR/public" "$SDIR/.next/static"; cp -r apps/web-main/public/. "$SDIR/public/" 2>/dev/null || true; cp -r apps/web-main/.next/static/. "$SDIR/.next/static/" 2>/dev/null || true; test -f "$SRV"

deploy.startCommand: sh -c "export NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 PORT=${PORT:-3000}; SERVER=/app/apps/web-main/.next/standalone/apps/web-main/server.js; if [ ! -f $SERVER ]; then SERVER=$(find /app/apps/web-main/.next/standalone -name server.js -print -quit); fi; if [ -z $SERVER ] || [ ! -f $SERVER ]; then echo 'standalone server.js not found'; find /app -maxdepth 6 -name server.js 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; echo Starting $SERVER; cd $(dirname $SERVER); exec node $SERVER"
